<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ScratchCard extends Model
{
    protected $keyType = 'string';
    public $incrementing = false;

    protected $fillable = [
        'id',
        'scratch_game_id',
        'member_id',
        'partner_id',
        'issued_by_staff_id',
        'is_played',
        'is_winner',
        'played_at',
        'identifier',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'is_played' => 'boolean',
        'is_winner' => 'boolean',
        'played_at' => 'datetime',
    ];

    protected static function boot()
    {
        parent::boot();
        static::creating(function ($model) {
            if (empty($model->id)) {
                $model->id = (string) Str::uuid();
            }
            if (empty($model->identifier)) {
                $model->identifier = strtoupper(Str::random(12));
            }
        });
    }

    public function scratchGame()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(ScratchGame::class);
    }

    public function member()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Member::class);
    }

    public function partner()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Partner::class);
    }

    public function issuedByStaff()
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Staff::class, 'issued_by_staff_id');
    }
}
